premises.text: Teams are forced to use too many tools to get work done, leading to data silos and decreased productivity
premises.evidence_span: teams are forced to use way too many tools to get their work done, tools that promise to streamline our workflows, improve our team collaboration, and bring our teams together

premises.text: Existing all-in-one workspaces have a high barrier of entry and cannot satisfy all team workflows
premises.evidence_span: they come with a higher barrier of entry. It's going to take time for your team to learn how to use this platform. Besides, it's impossible to have an all-in-one solution that satisfies your team's workflow

premises.text: Data integrators face setup challenges and provide limited interactivity between data
premises.evidence_span: the first problem here is just getting set up. If you don't have a technical background, you're going to run into some problems. But the main issue here is the level of interactivity between your data is limited

premises.text: Jamilius integrates with email to simplify teamwork and allows users to choose their preferred workspace
premises.evidence_span: we simplify teamwork by making collaboration platform agnostic. So imagine a company where every member of your team can choose their preferred workspace and be ensured that their data is seamlessly synced across your entire stack of tools

premises.text: Jamilius turns email conversations into flexible channels for communication across platforms
premises.evidence_span: we take your email conversations and turn them into flexible channels, channels that can then be translated into other forms of communication, whether that's a Slack message, a Trello card, or whatever your data type is on your preferred platform

premises.text: Jamilius provides real-time notifications and task management without leaving the email inbox
premises.evidence_span: he gets a real-time notification of that email and that note, but not just any type of synchronization. We're talking about an active, flexible piece of data that he can actually act on

premises.text: Jamilius offers a visual representation of email conversations and project tasks through Kanban boards
premises.evidence_span: Jamilius boards give you a visual representation of your email conversations and all of the projects and tasks that follow

premises.text: Jamilius operates in a large market with significant growth potential for team collaboration and workflow automation
premises.evidence_span: team collaboration will reach 17 billion. Workflow automation will reach 30 billion by the year 2025

value.text: Jamilius empowers teams to communicate and collaborate effectively across different platforms
value.evidence_span: the main point that we want to express is that our team in Geneva is ultra passionate about empowering teams and improving collaboration

notes: Traction metrics and Y Combinator mention excluded as they do not directly support premises.
